content.short: TON4U is a TON options trading project linked to the T4U token and smart-contract options activity.
content.description: TON4U is listed as a TON smart-contract options trading platform. Public market pages for the T4U/TON pool describe it as a Web3 TON options trading project, while the live site itself provides limited public detail. This entry is therefore written conservatively as a derivatives listing rather than making broader claims about liquidity or product maturity. For Ton4You, the TON value is the specific DeFi action it enables, from market access and routing to yield, liquidity, or position management.
